threshold_basis.rule: Resolves raw TTM owner earnings (OCF minus absolute capex per normalized_owner_earnings_ttm_m_v2). Threshold 45,000 USD millions is ~23% below the judgment bridge anchor of ~58,500 USD millions (TTM OCF $148.5B less sustainable capex ~$90B). A Q3 2026 resolved value below 45,000 USD millions means actual filing cash generation is materially worse than the low-case reinvestment runway path (component low $10/sh vs base $40/sh), even after allowing for AI capex roll-off.

spec.derived_from: Primary evidence shows owner cash or capital structure materially worse than low case.
spec.rationale: Revision addressing rejected draft 236474e4fe2387c1bb958eab. Types the owner-cash leg of the reinvestment_runway prose falsifier for the AWS/AI and advertising runway component ($10 low / $40 base / $90 high per share). **[Fact]** At information cutoff, Q1 2026 TTM operating cash flow was 148,531 USD millions and TTM capital expenditures (us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireProductiveAssets) were 151,003 USD millions, yielding raw TTM owner earnings of -2,472 USD millions via normalized_owner_earnings_ttm_m_v2 replay (AMZN/investor-documents/sec-edgar/10-Q_20260430_rpt20260331_acc0001018724_26_000014.htm). **[Fact]** Q3 2026 TTM is unobservable at registration (expected 10-Q ~2026-10-31 per AMZN/investor-documents/DOWNLOAD_MANIFEST.json). **Recovery bridge (probability):** For the falsifier not to fire, Q3 2026 TTM owner earnings must reach at least 45,000 USD millions, requiring TTM capex to fall to roughly 103,500 USD millions while OCF holds near 148,500 USD millions (a ~47.5B TTM capex reduction from the Q1 2026 cutoff). That path needs heavy AI capex quarters to roll out of the TTM window and/or a material moderation in new spending; management continues to guide elevated 2026 infrastructure investment, so recovery by Q3 2026 is possible but not base-case. Assign 18% P(recovery to >=45,000M) and 82% P(fire). Incremental after-tax ROIC and ads/AWS growth legs remain judgment inputs without a resolvable SEC metric and are not typed here. Historical adapter replay on Q3 FY2016 TTM resolved 9,056 USD millions via sec_companyfacts_ttm with PaymentsToAcquirePropertyPlantAndEquipment.
